tasks.label: backend: run (with auto-reload)
tasks.command: ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --reload --reload-dir src --reload-dir backend --reload-dir config --reload-dir modules --port 8000

tasks.label: wait: backend healthy
tasks.command: for ($i=0; $i -lt 30; $i++) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://127.0.0.1:8000/health -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 1; if ($r.StatusCode -eq 200) { Write-Host 'Backend is up.'; exit 0 } } catch {}; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; Write-Host 'Backend did not respond within 30s - check the "backend: run" terminal tab for the actual error.'; exit 1

tasks.label: Run the App (starts backend + frontend, opens browser)
